areas.host: The Electron main process. It owns what a web page cannot do: the window, saving boards, Obsidian vaults, Claude Code, exports, speech, updates.
areas.other: Hooks that run the type check and fast checks while Claude Code edits the repository.
areas.shared: Types and rules both sides rely on: the bridge operations, the card-type table, the board model and the check on Myra’s replies.
areas.static: Static files the page loads as they are: the generated icon pack, the licence text and the offline service worker.
areas.tests: Headless Electron tests, the perf benchmark and fixtures.
areas.tests/smoke: The sections of the end-to-end smoke test, each driving the real app through one area.
areas.tools: Build and project scripts: the bundler, the budget, name and icon generators, notices and the visual diff.
areas.web (root): Renderer entry points: main.ts starts every module in a fixed order, bridge.ts is the way to the host, and the files that draw Myra and the icons.
areas.web/app: First-run setup and tour, the what’s-new card, update checks, start-up and the hooks the tests use.
areas.web/canvas: The board itself: drawing cards, the pointer (drag, resize, connect, pan), copy, paste and drop, connector lines, zoom and view.
areas.web/cards: Behaviour that belongs to one kind of card: collections and kanban, canvases, cropping, links, Spotify, shapes, image fills.
areas.web/content: Starter boards and templates, such as Design thinking and Workshop planning, and the code that places them on a board.
areas.web/core: Foundations everything stands on: DOM handles, the state of the open board, undo and saving, small helpers and colours.
areas.web/docs: Doc cards: the document editor, its menus and toolbar, dropping cards into a doc, Word and PDF export, Myra rewriting a selection.
areas.web/edit: Editing the words on a card, and making a note grow or shrink to fit its text.
areas.web/features: Features that cut across cards: due dates, tags, find, quick capture, focus mode, your own templates, timers, export.
areas.web/library: The left-hand library of projects, folders and boards: opening, renaming, ordering, nesting, deleting, and the home view.
areas.web/media: Audio and video cards: recording, choosing the camera and microphone, stills, and sound extracted for speech.
areas.web/model: The board factory: new boards, the card maker and the bundled templates.
areas.web/myra: Myra herself: her chat, what she can do to the board, greetings, animations, hopping and perching, birthday.
areas.web/panels: The floating panels: Layers, the Unsorted tray and the zoom menu.
areas.web/platform: Things that depend on the device: Mac, Linux or Windows wording, and the phone layout.
areas.web/proto: Prototype boards: the preview, code pane, controls, git bar, building with Myra and keeping code in step with GitHub.
areas.web/repo: Linking a project to a git repo and GitHub, prototyping folders, and starting a prototype from anywhere.
areas.web/richtext: Rich text in notes: the small Markdown a note's text is stored in, its model, and conversion to and from markup, the editor and the clipboard.
areas.web/selbar: The selection bar: colour, text, fill, stroke, corners, arrange and due-date controls for whatever is selected.
areas.web/settings: Settings and looks: colours and themes, widget docking, panel heights, the name-tag cursor, and Myra’s small messages.
areas.web/tools: The tools that make things: pen, ink drawing, shape and stamp pickers, and placing a new card.
areas.web/ui: Shared interface parts: popovers, dialogs, the colour picker, palette, toolbar, minimisable boxes and DOM helpers.
areas.web/vault: Obsidian vault support in the page: connecting vaults, who may read them, vault note cards, and notes or tasks gathered for Myra.
areas.web/wireframe: Wireframe design: the elements Myra and you place, screens, the design panel, sections, stacking order and tilt.
